# GW-BASIC, as vendored here

Microsoft released the 1983 GW-BASIC source under the MIT licence on 21 May 2020. This copy is TK
Chia's fork (codeberg.org/tkchia/GW-BASIC, branch `tkchia/devel`), which adds the missing OEM
modules and assembles with JWasm. The commit is in `UPSTREAM`. Only the files needed to build
`GWBASIC.EXE` are kept. `LICENSE` is the MIT licence, copyright Microsoft Corporation.
